labs.title: Spectrum Monitoring
labs.summary: ADALM-Pluto + GNU Radio 3.10: frequency axis and complex baseband, a loopback test with a known tone (accurate to 0.5 Hz), band scans with Max Hold and waterfall, and identification of GSM900 and UMTS900 carriers. All results on the report page are computed in the browser from our raw I/Q recordings.
tasks: Run the Pluto from GNU Radio and read the real settings back from the device
Loopback tone: positive/negative baseband frequencies and the LO test (peak slopes s = 0, 1, ±4)
Band scans at 20 MS/s: GSM900 downlink, FM, 1.1 GHz; Welch PSD, 99 % OBW and x-dB bandwidth
Reference-frequency error of the Pluto from the GSM 200 kHz grid

labs.title: Noise Figure, P1dB and IIP3
labs.summary: Noise figure, compression and intermodulation of the ADALM-Pluto receiver, measured with the Pluto's own transmitter as noise and tone source. The report is computed from our data sheets and from 26 raw I/Q captures; the captures showed that the transmitter was on only two thirds of the time, which shifts every averaged reading by 1.78 dB.
tasks: Noise figure by the Y-factor and direct methods at three gains: 2.4 dB (49.6), 2.7 dB (40.2), 9.4 dB (29.7)
Single-tone sweep: ADC full scale at −48.2 dBm, P1dB ≈ −46 dBm, compression is ADC clipping
Two-tone test: no slope-3 region at this gain, so only a lower bound IIP3 ≥ −28.6 dBm
Antenna link sweep 400–3000 MHz: 3 dB band 1624–1749 MHz
Pre-lab: theory, GNU Radio simulation of the course receiver model, prediction tables
